content_sections.heading: About TNJFU Assistant Professor (Contractual)
content_sections.text: Fisheries College and Research Institute, Thoothukudi is a constituent institute functioning under Tamil Nadu Dr. J. Jayalalithaa Fisheries University. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual to carry out teaching and research assistance in the Department of Aquaculture at Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in TNJFU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for the post of Assistant Professor (Contractual) in the Department of Aquaculture.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TNJFU Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application along with necessary documents is 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.F.Sc. in Aquaculture, Fish Biotechnology, Fish Genetics and Breeding, or Fish Nutrition & Feed Technology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the preferred qualification for the post?
faq.answer: The preferred qualification stated in the notification is Ph.D. with NET or Ph.D.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Assistant Professor (Contractual) in TNJFU?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 50,000/- PM for M.F.Sc. with Ph.D., Rs. 45,000/- PM for M.F.Sc. with NET, and Rs. 40,000/- PM for M.F.Sc. candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is as per Tamil Nadu Government rules.

faq.question: Q7. How will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: Candidates should attend the interview online on getting the call letter.

faq.question: Q8. Is the TNJFU Assistant Professor post permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The post is purely temporary and engaged on a contractual basis.
